name: Setite Sorcery (The Immanence of Set) — Basic — Whisper of the Sands

system.description:
The shared blood of Set binds all his Followers together, letting a Serpent project his thoughts to his own servants and childer no matter the distance between them. This power lets a sorcerer share news or set plans in motion across his whole network from hundreds of leagues away.

System: The player spends a Blood Trait and wins a Social challenge; on success the vampire may communicate a short message (no more than two sentences) to any of his progeny or ghouls regardless of distance. The link lasts one turn, but can be extended a turn at a time by spending a Willpower Trait for each.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Three: Serpents
system.duration: One turn per additional Willpower spent
